lines:
Review follow-up on the design index and Markdown integration (second round, commit 14506a9).

Tree (src/main.tsx DesignTree/DesignTreeItem): the always-expanded mode is gone. Only the branch of the element shown in the viewer opens by itself, other branches keep the state the user gave them, and the tree starts collapsed. Selecting an element in the diagram or the tree reveals and scrolls to its own branch.

Document view: the document now renders inside the design viewer panel (.viewer-panel.document-open) instead of taking over the main column, so the header keeps the tree breadcrumb (System Context > ... > element) and the panel keeps the same background, border and heading as every other view. The document's own breadcrumb is gone. Opening a document no longer switches the index listing, so the tree stays where the user left it; task/QA jumps still open the Documents list.

Right panel (DocumentsBrowser.tsx DocumentInspector): while a document is open the inspector column shows that document instead of another entity, with the same inspector markup as the element and relationship panels (eyebrow, h3, identity note, Related designs, Referenced by). The editor area no longer repeats those links; the editable Associations stay in the document form. The element and relationship inspectors keep their Documents section. A documentRefresh counter re-reads the inspector after association edits, saves and discards only, so typing a body character does not re-read the document.

UI mockups: a new "UI Mockup" index mode lists every mockup flat (title, status, attachment). UML Artifacts now lists UML diagrams only.

Acceptance: npx tsc --noEmit clean; QA job 249560800 run 5686118898 (build, npm run build) passed on 2026-09-29; node --check on the edited scripts. The five native scripts follow the new contract again (index mode tabs, Design documents list, .document-workspace, document inspector heading, design breadcrumb to leave the document, document list buttons carry an explicit aria-label). Not verified here: the native Playwright/WebView2 suites cannot run on this Linux host and the GUI was not visually inspected.

Rework the Adashi desktop design workspace so Markdown design documents are first-class design artefacts inside the design panel instead of a separate replacing panel, and rework the design tree navigation.

Scope
1. Design tree navigation (src/main.tsx DesignBrowser index panel):
   - Rename the "System Context" level tab to "Tree View". It shows the whole C4 tree, always expanded, with the element currently shown in the viewer selected/scrolled into view.
   - After the tree, list all artefacts (UML diagrams and Markdown documents) that are not attached/linked anywhere in the tree, each clickable.
   - Below the "Tree View" button add buttons: Components, UML Artifacts, Documents. Selecting one shows a flat list of all artefacts of that kind instead of the tree.
2. Markdown documents open inside the design panel (main column) while the design index and inspector stay visible; they no longer replace the whole workspace. Documents mode of the index lists the documents with New/Import/find.
3. Markdown documents link to any C4 element (Software System, Container, Component) and appear as clickable links in that element's view (viewer header links already exist; add the linked-document list to the element inspector).
4. Markdown editor fixes: open in Preview by default, and make long content scrollable instead of being clipped.

Acceptance
- `npm run build` (tsc + vite) succeeds with no type errors.
- Manual: selecting a document keeps the design index + inspector; the tree shows Tree View, Components, UML Artifacts, Documents modes; the editor starts in Preview; long documents scroll.

data.title: Integrate Markdown documents into the design panel and rework design tree navigation
